viruddha_ahara.definition: Foods that dislodge vitiated dosas from their normal locations but cannot expel them from the body, acting antagonistically to tissues. Also includes foods with mutually contradictory qualities, incompatible combinations, or incompatible methods of preparation.

types_of_incompatibility.example: Water not to be taken before/after Saktu
Milk + Jackfruit (both sweet but still incompatible)

consequences: Loss of vigor, strength, memory, intelligence, sense perception

combinations.food_2: Masa + Honey + Milk + Germinated seeds + Lotus stalks + Radish + Jaggery

combinations.consequence: Channel obstruction (Srotorodha); opposite potency — fish is hot, milk is cold; both Madhura rasa + Madhura vipaka

combinations.food_2: Masa soup / Jaggery / Milk / Curd / Ghee
Vessel previously used for fish or Sunthi

combinations.food_1: Honey + Ghee + Muscle fat + Oil + Water
combinations.food_2: Equal quantities of any 2, 3, 4, or all 5

combinations.consequence: Toxic — three types of alcohol together

combinations.food_2: Cooked with Eranda firewood or Eranda oil

combinations.consequence: Both sweet, cold, and sweet vipaka — yet incompatible due to similar qualities

exceptions: Persons with strong digestive fire (Teekshna Agni)
When incompatible food is consumed in very small quantity
When the body has become gradually accustomed to the food over long time

gradual_discontinuation_protocol.description: 8-day protocol for gradually replacing unwholesome with wholesome diet
gradual_discontinuation_protocol.note: Sudden discontinuation also causes disease. Gradual transition is essential.

nidra_protocol.title: Nidra (Sleep) Regimen
nidra_protocol.importance: All of happiness/misery, nourishment/emaciation, strength/weakness, virility/sterility, knowledge/ignorance, life/death depend on proper or improper sleep.
nidra_protocol.physiology: Sleep arises from Tamas; Kapha obstructing internal channels after food causes sensory exhaustion leading to sleep.
day_sleep_indications: Summer season (Grisma Rtu) — short nights cause Vata aggravation
After excessive study, long travel, vehicle riding
After alcohol, sexual activity, heavy physical labor
Old persons, children, weak and emaciated persons
sleeplessness_remedies: Milk, alcoholic preparations, mutton juice, curds
sleep_types_7: Agantuka — Indicative of bad prognosis (impending death)

maithuna_protocol.post_coital_regimen: Bath + sandalwood paste + cold breeze + sugar candy, milk, mutton soup, cold water, Sura/Prasanna (alcohol) → then sleep. Restores vigor quickly.
